gen-dafont-visitor-gf-esteban: Retro and gap-mouthed, Visitor looks pulled from an old screen. Esteban, a serif with oversized lowercase and thins barely lighter than its stems, keeps paragraph after paragraph moving without strain.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-faustina: Nostalgic Visitor draws curves that never thin at the shoulders. Faustina, a classic serif with tempered contrast that neither jolts nor flattens, takes over below, so the uniform headline gives way to gently thinning bowls.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-halant: Visitor draws horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its stems, which gives it that nostalgic digital bluntness. Halant, a classic serif with a modest thick-thin shift and towering x-height, makes extended reading feel sturdy and traditional.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-headland-one: Every stroke in Visitor holds a single constant width, which is what gives it that nostalgic, solder-pulled digital look. Headland One, a serif spaced well apart, can take a slightly larger size.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Sturdy, open-ended curves and a tall lowercase give the body text a classic serif authority. Hedvig Letters Serif is built for sustained reading, while Visitor's wire-like lines do their best work up in the heading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-marcellus-sc: Nostalgic marker-traced strokes in Visitor give the heading a digital, retro hum. Marcellus SC, a serif with hairlines of reasonable sturdiness and gentle modulation, brings a dignified, literary counterweight underneath.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Retro and gap-mouthed, Visitor keeps every letter free of weight changes. And Noto Serif Hentaigana, a text serif whose subtle modulation never turns dramatic, is the refined foil that makes the pairing work.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a soft gradient of weight along each rounded stroke. Visitor handles the nostalgic headline punch, Ovo the paragraphs.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-esteban: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with a wide channel into every bowl and low stroke contrast. And Esteban's modest, engraved-brass contrast and oversized lowercase echo Woodgod's tall letters, which is what binds them.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-faustina: Faustina brings a faint swell to each curve, like pulled taffy, under Woodgod's low-contrast, vintage, commanding headline. Its open-jawed c and tall lowercase keep paragraphs moving at a comfortable pace.
